// diagnostic

E0121

Value used after it was given away

What

Value used after it was given away

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0121

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0121: tests/ui/cffi_callback_runtime_handle.stderr.

Error [E0121]: `handle` was given away earlier, so it can't be used here
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_runtime_handle.jet:5:12
    |
  5 |     return handle.join() ?? 0
    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: after a value moves to another name, the old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: give away a copy instead (`~handle`) where it moved
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0121

Error [E3203]: `fn(I32) I32 -[]>` is not a C-compatible type for a foreign function parameter or return.
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_runtime_handle.jet:12:25
    |
 12 | fn run() { print(c.call(schedules, 1)) }
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Extern` / `#Bindgen` functions must use types with a stable C ABI at the edge.
 Fix: use scalars, `String`, or a struct with C layout; pointers only through the gated tier.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3203

Error [E0112]: `call` wants fn(I32) I32 -[]> here, but this is fn(x: I32) I32 -[]>
  --> tests/ui/cffi_callback_runtime_handle.jet:12:25
    |
 12 | fn run() { print(c.call(schedules, 1)) }
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: use fn(I32) I32 -[]> here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112
